protocol_id_rule: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON scientific_spec with sorted keys and compact separators

scientific_spec.scope: single-model single-corpus matched multi-seed Pythia-70M LoRA study
scientific_spec.study_question: Does periodic-suffix filtering improve held-out greedy-generation loop scores relative to broad model-top-k history unlikelihood without material held-out causal-LM loss regression?

implementation.required_source_state: objective execution must use this exact commit or a clean descendant containing only this prespecification and its frozen prompt set

training.seed_provenance: fresh prime seeds not used in the tracked repetition-unlikelihood benchmark specifications
training.single_factor_rule: The candidate_source kind is the only intended difference between paired arms.
training.no_retuning_rule: Do not change strength, proposal_top_k, context_window, candidate cap, seeds, prompt set, horizon, or acceptance thresholds after any study run begins.

generation_endpoint.prompt_provenance: fresh independent prompts fixed before training and not selected from prior or current model outputs

decoding.seed: same seed as the training run

metrics.primary_effect: model_topk_periodic_minus_model_topk_history paired by seed, lower is better
metrics.primary_aggregate: arithmetic mean of the three paired seed effects

acceptance.generation_evidence_validation: every report must round-trip through validate_zspace_generation_evidence in the Rust semantic core
identity_requirements: verified model runtime, execution, corpus materialization, tokenized dataset, training recipe, and finetune replay identities
one prompt_set_id across all six generation reports
one decoding_config_id per seed shared by both arms
content-addressed adapter identity for every generation report
stability_requirements: no non-finite before-train or after-train evaluation loss
no failed or partial optimizer trajectory receipt
no failed, empty, or malformed generation row
no early termination before 64 optimizer updates
objective receipts ready for all six runs
mechanism_requirements: periodic_candidate_count must be positive in every model_topk_periodic run
excluded_non_periodic_proposal_count must be positive in every model_topk_periodic run
periodic_candidate_count must be zero in every model_topk_history run
acceptance.decision_rule: Pass only if all readiness, stability, mechanism, identity, primary, and safety requirements hold. Record ready-but-negative if execution is ready but an efficacy or safety gate fails; record blocked if a readiness or mechanism requirement fails.

interpretation.allowed_positive_claim: Within this prespecified bounded Pythia-70M/Dubliners pilot, periodic filtering improved the selected loop metric relative to broad history candidates with the required seed direction and without material held-out CE regression.
interpretation.allowed_negative_claim: This frozen periodic candidate recipe did not satisfy the prespecified bounded pilot gate.
interpretation.promotion_if_passed: run a separately prespecified multi-model and multi-corpus study with semantic-quality evaluation
